messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from this morning's outage tied to external control-plane spikes + model-registry auth turbulence. Need owners, realistic ETA, and a short-term mitigation plan.
ops-bot: Incident created: 2026-05-18-P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-05-18 :spiral_note_pad:
sam: short root cause: vendor control-plane returned bursts of 500/429, our client retried aggressively, registry TTL fallback was effectively zero causing renewal storms.
joel: proposed immediate mitigations and owners: 
- REMEDY-001: client exponential backoff + per-tenant token limiter (owner: joel, eta: 2026-05-21, est: 8h)
- REMEDY-002: registry safe-TTL floor + auto-throttle on auth errors (owner: sam, eta: 2026-05-28, est: 12h)
- REMEDY-003: regional token-refresh canary (owner: maria, PoC: 2026-05-20, rollout: 2026-06-02, est: 6h)
kevin: vendor comms owner: I'll open an escalation and request their control-plane postmortem plus an operational contact. owner: kevin, eta: 2026-05-27.
sam: add CI regression that injects 5xx/429 into auth path to validate graceful fallback (owner: sam, eta: 2026-05-24, est: 4h).
joel: quick PoC snippet for the canary: ```curl -s -X POST https://registry.internal/refresh -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CANARY\" -d '{}' || echo 'refresh-fail'``` runs every 5m per region.
maria: recurring pattern note: ops shows repeated small auth interruptions during vendor maintenance windows over last 6 months. recommend monthly "auth-path resilience" drill owned by ops-sre rotation. first drill: 2026-06-05.
kevin: also recommend we ask vendor for a soft throttle/quota for our control-plane client and a joint quarterly drill. I'll track that in vendor ticket.
sam: can we get owners to add estimated hours to the tracker so PM can decide sprint pull vs hotfix sprint?
joel: REMEDY-001 hours: 8h. REMEDY-003 PoC: 6h.
sam: REMEDY-002 hours: 12h. CI test: 4h.
maria: I'll run a short weekly 20m triage until the high-priority actions are closed (Mon 09:15 PT). ops-bot: Weekly reminder created: auth-remediation-triage Mon 09:15 PT invited: maria, sam, joel, kevin.
kevin: I'll upload vendor ticket reference to the tracker (internal-only).
sam: one clarifying item: REMEDY-002 will be config-only with a feature-flag fallback, no DB migration.
joel: noted. we'll gate the rollout with the canary alerts.
maria: final: please react with :white_check_mark: in the tracker when you've confirmed hours/ETA. I'll close the thread once tracker is canonical.
all: :white_check_mark:
